title: Immediate First Order Percentage
scenario: Calculate the percentage of immediate orders in the first orders of all customers. An order is immediate if order_date equals customer_pref_delivery_date. Return the result as 'immediate_percentage'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Find the minimum order_date per customer first, then filter for those records.
correctQuery: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS immediate_percentage FROM delivery WHERE (customer_id, order_date) IN (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) FROM delivery GROUP BY customer_id);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE); INSERT INTO delivery VALUES (1, 1, '2019-08-01', '2019-08-02'), (2, 2, '2019-08-02', '2019-08-02');
